headlines.title: Progressive activist wins Democratic primary in one of the nation’s biggest House races
headlines.description: Democrat William Lawrence, a co-founder of the progressive Sunrise Movement, has won his party’s primary in Michigan’s 7th Congressional District, NBC News projects — a big victory for the insurgent left that also sets up a dramatic general election contrast with Republicans in a crucial battleground seat.

headlines.title: Trump-backed John James wins Michigan’s GOP primary for governor
headlines.description: Rep. John James has won Michigan’s Republican nomination for governor, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Rep. Wesley Bell defeats former Rep. Cori Bush in a Missouri Democratic primary rematch
headlines.description: Bell won, NBC News projects, with ad support from a pro-Israel super PAC, while Bush had backing from prominent progressives.

headlines.title: GOP’s Ty Masterson and Democrat Cindy Holscher to meet in Kansas governor’s race
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Masterson, the state Senate president, emerged from the primary in a contest that represents a top pickup opportunity for the GOP this fall.

headlines.title: Missouri voters block GOP-led effort to raise bar to pass constitutional amendments
headlines.description: The push came after progressives in the solidly Republican state found success with ballot measures related to abortion, health care and the minimum wage.

headlines.title: Senate Judiciary Committee advances Todd Blanche's attorney general nomination
headlines.description: Republicans on the Senate Judiciary Committee voted to advance acting Attorney General Todd Blanche's nomination to serve in the role permanently. NBC News' Scott Wong and Gabe Gutierrez have details on what senators had to say in support or opposition of the nomination and when it will face a full Senate vote.

headlines.title: Olympic canoeist charged by Jeanine Pirro seeks to permanently sink Reflecting Pool case
headlines.description: Attorneys for the former Olympic canoeist the Trump administration had charged in a felony Reflecting Pool case are seeking to permanently bar any effort to resurface what they called a “politically motivated prosecution” of their client.

headlines.title: Suspect arrested in connection to devastating Spokane wildfire
headlines.description: A man with a previous manslaughter conviction was arrested in Spokane, WA and had his first appearance in court today. Authorities say he is responsible for the fire that has reduced hundreds of homes to rubble and forced thousands of people to evacuate. NBC News’ Morgan Chesky reports.

headlines.title: Armed man arrested at Trump golf course
headlines.description: Police arrested a suspect they said was acting suspiciously on the property, taking photos and monitoring security. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz with the late-breaking details.

headlines.title: SpaceX hit by surging AI costs as insiders prepare to sell their shares
headlines.description: Capital expenditures related to its xAI unit, which runs the Grok service, hit $15.8 billion, more than double what they were in the first quarter.

headlines.title: McDonald’s struggles to attract bargain-hungry customers
headlines.description: McDonald’s just reported its slowest U.S. sales growth in over a year as its value push fell flat with customers who continue to struggle with higher prices.
